fields.description: Sector magic 'SBTL' written at buffer offset 0 on every save
fields.evidence: FUN_080217d0 stores ROM word _DAT_0802186c to sector buffer offset 0x0 (buffer _DAT_08021868, built with 0x1000-byte memset); baseline bytes at file offset 0 are 53 42 54 4c.
fields.name: save_magic_sbtl

fields.description: CRC32 (ISO-HDLC/zlib) of the 4096-byte sector with this word treated as zero; not in Schema v2 algorithm list so stored as a plain field
fields.evidence: FUN_080217d0 stores func_08021a40 (u32 init 0xFFFFFFFF, table _DAT_08021a80, final bitwise NOT) over 0x1000 bytes at offset 0x4; FUN_080216e4 zeroes buffer+4, recomputes func_08021a40 over 0x1000 and compares per sector; Python zlib.crc32 over baseline[0:0x1000] with bytes 4..7 zeroed equals stored LE value 0x23dfa272.
fields.name: sector_crc32

fields.description: Primary save-version counter; loader keeps the sector with the highest (counter_b, counter_a) pair
fields.evidence: FUN_080217d0 copies u32 _DAT_08021870[0] to sector offset 0x8; FUN_080216e4 scans 16 sectors via FUN_080218ac and selects max of *(uint*)(buf+0xc) then *(uint*)(buf+0x8); baseline value 1.
fields.name: save_version_counter_a

fields.description: Secondary save-version counter used together with counter_a for newest-sector arbitration
fields.evidence: FUN_080217d0 copies u32 _DAT_08021870[1] to sector offset 0xc; FUN_080216e4 arbitration compares buf+0xc before buf+0x8 across the 16 sectors read by FUN_080218ac; baseline value 0.
fields.name: save_version_counter_b

fields.description: First byte of the RAM game-state struct; chained-additive encode leaves index-0 byte unchanged, so this file byte equals the live struct byte (default-init writes u32 1 at struct+0x0)
fields.evidence: FUN_080215a8 writes u32 1 at RAM state struct offset 0x0 (_DAT_080216ac); FUN_080217d0 memcpys 0x4e0 bytes from RAM state (_DAT_08021874) to file offset 0x10; FUN_080219e4 encode loop modifies bytes 1..N only, preserving byte 0; baseline file byte 0x10 is 0x01.
fields.name: save_state_active

fields.description: Remainder of the 0x4e0-byte RAM game-state image after chained-additive obfuscation (plaintext not directly readable)
fields.evidence: FUN_080217d0 memcpys 0x4e0 bytes from _DAT_08021874 to file offset 0x10, then FUN_080219e4 obfuscates 0xff0 bytes from file offset 0x10 via table _DAT_08021a0c chained adds; first byte split out as save_state_active.
fields.name: game_state_encrypted

fields.description: Encoded zero padding filling the sector past the 0x4e0-byte state image (whole 0x1000 buffer is zeroed before the state copy and the 0xff0-byte encode pass)
fields.evidence: FUN_080217d0 zeroes the full 0x1000-byte buffer (_DAT_08021868), copies only 0x4e0 state bytes at offset 0x10, then FUN_080219e4 encodes 0xff0 bytes covering file offsets 0x10..0x1000; 0x10+0x4e0 = 0x4f0 boundary.
fields.name: sector_padding_encrypted

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'SBTL' sector magic written by FUN_080217d0
